verdict.rationale: Shopify POS does have automation-adjacent features, such as Shopify Flow-powered low-stock notifications and Sidekick creating stock transfers, so asking about automation versioning is fair for this product. However, the evidence never documents versioning, review, change history, or rollback of automations. Absent evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
